name: tracking-event-qa
description: Configure and verify product analytics tracking events against PostHog, with Notion write-back and optional Jira follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Verify QA analytics events with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Create reusable squad and product profiles, then verify tracking-plan events marked QA against real PostHog traffic per platform. Write evidence back to Notion and prepare optional Jira follow-ups without storing credentials.
defaultPrompt: Set up tracking QA for a squad and product.
Verify all tracking events currently marked QA.
Show the failed tracking events and their evidence.
